description: Karuah to Bulahdelah : Pacific Highway upgrading : environmental impact statement : working papers : volume 1 is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. The proposed upgrade of the pacific highway between Karuah and Buladelah involves the construction of two carriageways and removal of part of the existing carriageway along the pacific highway between a point about four kilometres north of the Karuah bridge and a point about 1.5 kilometres south of the Myall River bridge at Buladelah. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. Its tags are Roads and Traffic Authority of New South Wales. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing).
